mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_out_requests(elderly_id, bed_id, check_out_date, checkout_reason, checkout_type, approval_status, phone_number) VALUES (#{elderlyId}, #{bedId}, #{checkOutDate}, #{checkoutReason}, #{checkoutType}, 1, #{phoneNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.elderly_id, e.name, r.bed_id, r.phone_number, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.checkout_reason, r.checkout_type, r.approval_status, r.approval_time, r.approval_person FROM check_out_requests r LEFT JOIN elderly_info e ON r.elderly_id = e.elderly_id;
mapper.update: update check_out_requests set approval_status = 2, approval_person = #{adminId}, -- 审批人 approval_time = now() -- 审批时间 where elderly_id = #{elderlyId} -- 根据老人的ID查找退住申请记录

UPDATE check_out_requests SET approval_status = 3, approval_person = #{approvalPerson}, -- 撤销审批人 approval_time = now() -- 撤销审批时间 WHERE elderly_id = #{elderlyId} -- 根据老人的ID查找退住申请记录 AND approval_status = 2;
